sources.name: front-10a
sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One complete Tokenbook pixel-art animation sprite, same 1254x1254 canvas, genuine transparent alpha. Image 1 is the exact edit target. Image 2 is the earlier leg pose (front-10). Image 3 is the next passing pose (front-11). Correct ONLY the two legs/boots below the shorts so they progress between image2 and image3; the current legs lag behind the already-returning arms. Keep every head/face/single-ponytail/turquoise-bow/torso/arm/hand/shorts/belt/pouch pixel and all placement exactly as image1. No bun, no body scale change, no body bob, no face or palette change. Whole connected legs with soft knees and original volume, no cutout parts or marching high-knee. Match original crisp detailed pixel clusters, boot size, warm skin shading and dark outline. No blur, ghosts, added shadow, ground, props or labels. This is EARLY progress: the NEAR leg (origin at viewer-right hem of shorts) has swung 40 percent of the distance from image2's trailing bent leg to image3's low forward passing knee. Move its lifted boot about 15 source pixels LEFT from its CURRENT position, slightly bending the knee forward. Near boot's toe/shaft visible center around x738,y974, with sole around y1050; not high-knee. The FAR supporting leg remains firmly planted but its boot position advances about 40 percent toward image3 (around x562 with flat sole near y1119). Keep the shorts hem and proximal thigh join anchored to image1; anatomy flows naturally from unchanged hip to changed knee and boot. Both feet must truly advance beyond image1's pose, not simply redraw the same trailing leg.
